articles.title: JPMorgan files to launch new tokenized fund as Wall Street tokenization race heats up
articles.snippet: The global banking giant is expanding its tokenized money market lineup, following BlackRock's similar move just a few days ago.

articles.title: Kelp DAO eyes reopening withdrawals after rsETH burn
articles.snippet: Kelp DAO has burned the exploiter’s tokens and outlined a two-week plan to refill rsETH through Aave’s Recovery Guardian multisig wallet.

articles.title: US senators file over 100 amendments to crypto bill ahead of markup
articles.snippet: A leaked list shows Senate Banking Committee members have filed more than 100 amendments to a crypto bill, highlighting the issues likely to be debated at a markup on Thursday.

articles.title: JPMorgan to launch tokenized money market fund for stablecoin issuers
articles.snippet: JPMorgan’s filing comes nearly three weeks after rival investment bank Morgan Stanley launched its own money market fund, the Stablecoin Reserves Portfolio.

articles.title: JPMorgan Files to Launch Tokenized Money Market Fund on Ethereum
articles.snippet: Global banking giant JPMorgan filed for a new tokenized money market fund that will initially run on the Ethereum network.
